question: In which year was the Panchayats (Extension to the Schedules Areas) Act (PESA act) passed in India?
solution:
The correct answer is** __"1996''.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **PESA Act **was launched by the Government of India in 1996.
 
• This law was enacted for ensuring self-governance for people living in scheduled areas of India by traditional methods.
 
• The** Fifth Schedule** of the constitution of India identifies the schedule area.
 
• The schedule areas were not included in the **73rd Constitutional Amendment** so PESA was enacted to extend the provisions of the constitution by certain exceptions and modifications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Current affairs related to PESA Act:
 
 
• The Panchayat Extension to Scheduled Areas Act is recently implemented by **Madhya Pradesh Government** to avoid the exploitation of the tribal population. This was announced on the occasion of the** JanjatIya Gaurav Divas.**
 
 
 
• PESA Act is viewed as a positive step towards the development of people living in scheduled areas.
 
• This act was enacted on** 24 December 1996** to enable panchayats at different levels.
